name: AI in Transport, Logistics and Mobility: The One-Hour Briefing
description: A free one-hour briefing built on ten real transport jobs, not an overview: ranking late loads by predicted ETA, classifying an invoice to HTSUS, coaching from AI dash-cam events, turning aircraft-health alerts into work orders, coding safety reports, acting on machine-vision track findings, watchkeeping with an AI lookout, planning a CII-aware voyage, retesting a perception model and triaging satellite conjunctions. Each lesson shows where AI helps, where the person who signs must decide, and the rule that governs that task.
fieldOfStudy: AI in Transport, Logistics and Mobility

image.caption: Wirewalk Institute of AI badge: AI in Transport, Logistics and Mobility: The One-Hour Briefing

criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must: complete all 9 lessons in 3 modules; and pass the final exam: 10 questions, 15 minutes, pass mark 80%, at most 3 attempts, with a 24-hour wait after a failed attempt.

The exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits
